title: Simple and distinct zeros in a prime-modulus Dirichlet family from near-microscopic to polylogarithmic heights
summary: Fix \(η>0\) and \(A_0>0\). Let \(q\) tend to infinity through odd primes, put \(Q=\log q\), and let \(T=T(q)\) satisfy \[ \frac{(\log Q)^{1+η}}{Q}\le T\le Q^{A_0}. \] Set \(I=(T,2T]\), and sum without weights over the \(q-2\) nonprincipal characters modulo \(q\). Let \(\mathcal N_q\) count nontrivial zeros in \(I\) with multiplicity, let \(\mathcal N^s_{0,q}\) and \(\mathcal N^*_{0,q}\) count simple and distinct zeros on the critical line, and let \(\mathcal N_{d,q}\) count all distinct zeros in \(I\).
